title: Completion of a flat local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings is flat
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m_A)$ and $(B,\mathfrak m_B)$ be Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local rings and $\varphi:A\to B$ a flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] local homomorphism ($\varphi(\mathfrak m_A)\subseteq\mathfrak m_B$). Let $A^\wedge=\varprojlim_nA/\mathfrak m_A^n$ and $B^\wedge=\varprojlim_nB/\mathfrak m_B^n$ be the adic completions [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] with canonical maps $\iota_A:A\to A^\wedge$, $\iota_B:B\to B^\wedge$, and let $\varphi^\wedge:A^\wedge\to B^\wedge$ be the ring map $(a_n\bmod\mathfrak m_A^n)_n\mapsto(\varphi(a_n)\bmod\mathfrak m_B^n)_n$ (well defined since $\varphi(\mathfrak m_A^n)\subseteq\mathfrak m_B^n$), so that $\varphi^\wedge\circ\iota_A=\iota_B\circ\varphi$. Then $\varphi^\wedge$ is flat. (Stacks states the equivalence: $\varphi^\wedge$ is flat if and only if $\varphi$ is flat; only this direction is stated here.)

source.place: Lemma Tag 0C4G (more-algebra-lemma-flat-completion, line 10731), the direction 'A -> B flat implies A^ -> B^ flat' (proof via algebra.tex lemma-flat-module-powers)

proof.text: Use localness of phi to obtain map(phi,mA^n) <= mB^n. Define the quotient maps q_n : A/mA^n -> B/mB^n and f_n = q_n.comp eval_n. Cauchy-sequence representatives and compatibility of their residues show the f_n commute with transition maps. AdicCompletion.liftRingHom constructs phi_hat; eval_liftRingHom proves its levelwise formula and ext_eval proves phi_hat.comp iota_A = iota_B.comp phi.

proof.text: The canonical B -> Bhat map is flat, and flatness composes, so phi_hat.comp iota_A is flat.

proof.text: Finite generation of mA follows from Noetherianity. Apply flat_quotients_of_flat_restriction with I = mA, S = Bhat, f = phi_hat. This proves flatness of all quotients over Ahat/(mA Ahat)^n.

proof.text: The completions are Noetherian. The maximal ideal of Bhat is mB Bhat. Composition compatibility and map_map show the image of mA Ahat in Bhat is contained in mB Bhat by localness of phi. Bhat is finite over itself. Apply the local clause of flat_of_flat_quotients_powers to R = Ahat, S = M = Bhat, I = mA Ahat and the quotient flatness just proved. This gives phi_hat.Flat.

lean.statement: theorem flat_adicCompletion_of_flat_local (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing A] [IsLocalRing B] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] (φ : A →+* B) (hφ : φ.Flat) (hlocal : ∀ x : A, x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A → φ x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) : let mA : Ideal A := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A let mB : Ideal B := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B let Ahat := AdicCompletion mA A let Bhat := AdicCompletion mB B let ιA : A →+* Ahat := algebraMap A Ahat let ιB : B →+* Bhat := algebraMap B Bhat ∃ φhat : Ahat →+* Bhat, (∀ n : ℕ, ((AdicCompletion.evalₐ mB n).toRingHom).comp φhat = (Ideal.Quotient.lift (mA ^ n) ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (mB ^ n)).comp φ) (by intro x hx change Ideal.Quotient.mk (mB ^ n) (φ x) = 0 rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] exact (pow_le_pow_left' ((Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap).2 (by intro y hy exact hlocal y hy)) n) (by rw [← Ideal.map_pow] exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem φ hx)) ).comp (AdicCompletion.evalₐ mA n).toRingHom) ∧ φhat.comp ιA = ιB.comp φ ∧ φhat.Flat
